intent: Write a polite email reminding a client their invoice is 7 days overdue.

spec.goal: Remind a client politely that their invoice is 7 days overdue.
spec.deliverable: A written email (subject line and body) addressed to the client, ready to send.
constraints: Tone must be polite and courteous
The email must state that the invoice is 7 days overdue
The purpose is a reminder about payment of the invoice
Use placeholders for details not provided, such as client name, invoice number, amount and sender name
done_criteria: The email includes a subject line and a body
The email clearly says the invoice is 7 days overdue
The tone is polite and not accusatory
The email asks the client to arrange payment or get in touch if there is an issue
spec.summary: You want a polite email you can send to a client reminding them that their invoice is 7 days overdue.
